_note: Events v3: a content drop across every setting. Ids prefixed v3e_.

events.title: The Tide Bell
events.text: A bell hangs under the jetty. Below the waterline. It still rings. Every ring, the water climbs a step.

check.pass_text: It rings. Something under the water rings back. It leaves you a gift on the step.
check.fail_text: The water climbs. Over the step. Over your boots. It does not go back down.

check.pass_text: The bell sinks. Down there, a lot of things stop waiting. Some coins float up.
check.fail_text: The rope whips back. It was holding more than a bell.

events.title: Numbered Floats
events.text: Wooden balls bob on the black water. Numbers painted on. 7. 22. 45. His cage rattles each time one goes under.

options.label: Fish one out

rows.text: Number seven. Lucky. Lucky. He says it twice.
Number fifty-one. A card is stuck to it.
Number nought. There is no. Nought. He takes it off you.

options.result: The ball is heavier than wood should be.

check.pass_text: You call them in order. He goes very still. Then. 'Yes. Yes. That was. The order.'
check.fail_text: 'Wrong. Wrong. That is. My job.' Your dice feel cold for a while.

events.title: One Wellington
events.text: A single wellington boot, upright on the rocks. Size eleven. Biro inside the rim: STEVE. It is full. The water is warm.

options.label: Pour it out
options.result: Dice spill out with the water. Eleven of them. All ones. He counts them. Under his breath.

options.label: Drink from it
options.result: It tastes of pennies and laughing. Something in your chest stops trusting the dice.

options.label: Wear it
options.result: It fits. Of course it fits. Something rattles in the toe. You walk like him now.

events.title: The Tote Board
events.text: A betting board rises out of the moat. Every party that drowned here. Then yours. The odds on you are very long.

options.label: Bet on yourselves (40 gold)

rows.text: You live. The King pays out. In wet coins. Grudgingly.
The board changes your odds while you watch. The bet is void.

options.result: 'Brave. Brave. Wet.' The King takes your coins.

options.label: Bet against yourselves
options.result: 'Clever. Now you must lose. Or I. Will know.' He sends something big to make sure.

check.pass_text: Your names smear away. So does one of his rules. Nobody is watching the board.
check.fail_text: Your names will not come off. They are carved. He underlines them.

events.title: The Choir Below
events.text: Singing, from under the boards. Hymn numbers. The same as bingo numbers. Somebody down there is about to win.

check.pass_text: You know the words. You did not know you knew them. It helps.
check.fail_text: The singing stops. Everything down there turns to listen to you.

options.label: Drop coins through the gaps (20 gold)
options.result: Plink. Plink. The singing gets kinder. He notes your manners.

check.pass_text: A drowned hand offers you its prize card. It wants you to have it. It is so tired of holding it.
check.fail_text: Hands. Many hands. They take a card from you. And a finger, to be sure.

events.title: Drink, Breathe
events.text: The King offers a goblet of seawater. A tiny crown floats in it. 'Drink. Breathe water. Like me. Never. Leave.'

options.label: Drink
options.result: You breathe it. It stays in. You are heavier now, and harder to move. Harder to kill.

options.label: Take the tiny crown
options.result: 'Thief. Thief. Court!' The court climbs out of the moat to discuss it.

options.label: Pour it back into the moat
options.result: 'Rude.' He sulks. While he sulks, you rest.

events.title: The Collection Plate
events.text: The plate comes round. It is a dauber tray. Everyone in the pews puts in something warm.

options.label: Give gold (30 gold)
options.result: The deacon blesses you with a dauber. A red dot, on the forehead. You feel seen to.

options.label: Give blood
options.result: You bleed into the tray. The pews say amen. Your next fight goes better. Holier.

check.pass_text: You take more than you gave. Nobody saw. Something did.
check.fail_text: The whole church turns round. 'Thief.' He writes it in red.

events.title: Hymn Eighty-Eight
events.text: The board says HYMN 88. Two fat ladies. The congregation turns to you. You don't know the words. Nobody alive does.

check.pass_text: You make it up. They sing it back to you, word for word. As if it was always that.
check.fail_text: Wrong. The choir corrects you. All of them. All at once. For a long time.

check.pass_text: Nobody notices. He nods along. Good. Good. Blend.
check.fail_text: You mouth the wrong shape. He hears silence in the wrong place.

events.title: Pew Four
events.text: A cardigan, folded on the end of pew four. A dauber in the pocket. A note: SAVE ME A SEAT. J.

options.label: Wear the cardigan
options.result: It fits. The sleeves are very deep. He will notice the sleeves. He noticed hers.

options.label: Leave it folded
options.result: You save her the seat. 'Thank. You.' He sounds. Older.

check.pass_text: A spare die. A mint. Bus fare home. She was planning to leave.
check.fail_text: A pin. Then the cardigan's arms close round you. Briefly. Firmly.

events.title: The Ring Fingers
events.text: A glass box of saints' fingers. Every one wears a wedding ring. One finger still twitches. It points at you.

options.label: Take the twitching one
options.result: It stops pointing. Something else starts.

options.label: Take a ring
options.result: The ring comes off. Your finger goes with it. Fair trade. Says the saint.

check.pass_text: The fingers fold. In prayer. Your wounds close the way doors do.
check.fail_text: Every finger points at you now.

events.title: The Warm Altar
events.text: The altar has a pulse. Lay a hand on it and it learns your shape. Lay something precious on it and it gives back.

options.label: Offer a relic
options.result: It swallows. It thinks. It gives back something bigger. Wetter.

options.label: Offer yourself
options.result: It takes a little of you. What is left is stronger. Less of it.

events.title: Booth Out of Order
events.text: A confession booth. A raffle drum where the grille should be. Put in your sin. Draw out someone else's.

options.label: Confess a cheat
options.result: He hears it. He is not angry. He takes a card. As a. Receipt.

check.pass_text: Janet's. A trick with a sleeve. You understand it immediately.
check.fail_text: It is Derek's sin. It is a rule. It is yours now.

events.title: Clocking In
events.text: A rack of time cards. Yours are there, already punched. Departure: blank. One old card reads LINDA. 1986. Departure: blank.

check.pass_text: Clunk. Shift over. You sit down somewhere quiet. He will check the cards later.
check.fail_text: The machine rings. A foreman comes. Several foremen.

options.label: Work a double
options.result: Sixteen hours on the line. You can't remember what you made. The pay is real.

options.label: Punch Linda out
options.result: Clunk. Far away, under a dust sheet, something sighs. The Caller is quiet. 'Thank. You.'

events.title: Weighed Out
events.text: 'Gold for meat. Meat for gold. Fair weight.' The scales are rusted to one side. The other pan holds false teeth.

options.label: Trade flesh
options.result: He weighs you. Generously. He takes it from somewhere you won't miss. Much.

options.label: Trade gold (50 gold)
options.result: He gives you meat. You don't ask whose. Everyone feels sturdier.

check.pass_text: The pan slams down. Gold slides off. He doesn't notice. Too busy with the teeth.
check.fail_text: 'Thumb. On the. Scale.' The prospector calls his friends.

events.title: The Boiler
events.text: A boiler with a door like an oven. Inside, it is not coal. It is dice. Thousands. Glowing.

check.pass_text: The engine roars. So do you.
check.fail_text: The door bangs open. Hot dice. Everywhere.

options.label: Pull a die out
options.result: You reach in. You pull one out. Your hand stays a bit. In there.

options.label: Shut the door
options.result: The line slows. Everything you meet next is tired. He liked the noise.

events.title: Back Pay
events.text: A payroll ledger. Wages owed to workers who never clocked out. The total is enormous. The names are from the table.

check.pass_text: You forge four signatures. Steve's is easy. Everyone's is easy.
check.fail_text: The ledger knows their handwriting. It knows yours better.

options.label: Settle their debts (40 gold)
options.result: You pay what they owed. Somewhere, a tab is closed. Sandra's, probably.

options.label: Burn the ledger
options.result: It goes up fast. A rule goes with it. So does your sleeve.

events.title: Points Failure
events.text: Two tracks. One lever. On one line, a stranger, tied down. On the other, your gold. The train is a bingo cage on wheels.

options.label: Save the stranger
options.result: The cage runs over your purse. The stranger stands up. Takes a seat. Says nothing.

options.label: Save the gold
options.result: The cage rolls on. You don't look. He does. He writes something down.

check.pass_text: The cage tips. Numbers everywhere. One of them is a prize.
check.fail_text: It doesn't tip. It turns. Towards you.

events.title: The Canary
events.text: A canary in a cage of rib bones. It sings bingo numbers. When it stops, the shaft fills with something.

options.label: Feed it (15 gold)
options.result: It sings louder. Kelly's eye. Number one. You feel watched over.

options.label: Wring its neck
options.result: Quiet. Then a new rule, chalked on the wall in a hand you don't know.

check.pass_text: Not numbers. Directions. Down here, behind the third prop.
check.fail_text: Numbers in your head. They stay. Next fight, you lose count.

events.title: Ash on the Map
events.text: Cigarette ash drifts down onto the map. He does not smoke. He has no mouth. The ash spells a word. EYES.

options.label: Blow it off
options.result: Gone. 'Thank you. Sorry. That. Is old.'

check.pass_text: EYES DOWN. HE CHEATS. SEAT TWO. It all blows away.
check.fail_text: Ash in your eyes. It does not wash out. Not for a while.

events.title: Under the Dust Sheet
events.text: The edge of the map peels back. Under it: the real hall. Seat one. A dust sheet over a shape still holding a handbag.

check.pass_text: She is smiling. She is still smiling. She hands you something from the bag.
check.fail_text: You don't get to see. He does it for you. Gently. Then not.

options.label: Tuck her back in
options.result: You smooth the sheet. He stops. Then lets you. 'She. Gets cold.'

options.label: Take the handbag
options.result: Purse. Mints. Something has started following you. A new rule, in her handwriting.

events.title: The Flashboard
events.text: The hall's number board flickers across the sky. Lights come on, one by one. When the last lights, someone wins.

check.pass_text: Eighty-nine lit. One left. You count it out loud before he does. A prize.
check.fail_text: You count wrong. He counts right. He counts you.

check.pass_text: Dark. The next fight starts in the dark. They can't see you either.
check.fail_text: Glass. Then the board relights. Brighter. Angrier.

events.title: Eyes Down
events.text: 'Eyes. Down.' Everyone looks at their sheet. You don't. Behind him the hall door is open. A crack.

check.pass_text: Outside: a car park. Rain. A car with its lights on. Somebody waiting. Still.
check.fail_text: His cage turns. All the way round. 'I. Said. Down.'

options.label: Eyes down
options.result: Good. Good. He reads the numbers softly. Like a bedtime story.

events.title: The Tea Urn
events.text: An urn at the edge of the map, hissing. Paper cups. A sign: 10p A CUP. HONESTY BOX. The box is full of teeth.

options.label: Pay (10 gold)
options.result: Stewed. Sweet. The best thing that has happened tonight.

options.label: Help yourselves
options.result: Just as sweet. He doesn't say anything. He doesn't need to.

options.label: Put in a tooth
options.result: The box rattles. It gives you change.

events.title: Old Bingo Cards
events.text: A stack of bingo cards, decades of them. The same five numbers circled on every one. Somebody was telling somebody something.

check.pass_text: It's how he looks away. When. For how long. Pauline worked it out. Nineteen years.
check.fail_text: He takes the cards back. One at a time. Off your fingers.

options.label: Burn them for warmth
options.result: The cards curl up. One of his rules goes with them. He doesn't notice. Yet.

options.label: Pocket one
options.result: Seat four. 2001. Dabbed so hard it went through.

events.title: Pink Ticket
events.text: Someone has pressed a raffle ticket into your hand. Pink. Number 1974. The year Maureen sat down.

options.label: Claim the prize

rows.text: A tin of biscuits. Under the biscuits, something better.
Two cards, still in the cellophane.
The prize is a rule. The rule is yours now.

options.result: The clerk checks the number. Twice. Then a third time.

options.label: Tear it up
options.result: Maureen would have kept it. Maureen would have remembered you tearing it.

events.title: The Interval
events.text: 'Interval. Ten minutes. Do not. Leave. Your seats.' The lights come up. For ten minutes, the hall is real.

check.pass_text: The bar. The toilets. A fire exit, chained. You bring back something from the bar.
check.fail_text: You are not in your seat when the lights go down. He was counting.

options.label: Stay seated
options.result: You sit. He watches you sit. 'Good. Good. Everyone. Stays.'

options.label: Go to the toilets
options.result: The toilets are on the board. Something in the end cubicle has been waiting. It has change for the machine.

events.title: Meat Raffle
events.text: A meat raffle. A pound a strip. The tray is covered with a tea towel. The tea towel is breathing.

options.label: Buy a strip (20 gold)

rows.text: Bad meat. Full refund. Plus interest.
It bites back. It likes you.

options.result: Number called. Yours. The auctioneer wraps it in newspaper.

check.pass_text: Under the towel, among the cuts: a prize. Unclaimed since 1999.
check.fail_text: It looks at you. The meat looks at you.

events.title: A Fifth Chair
events.text: There is a fifth chair at the table tonight. Nobody sits in it. The cushion is warm. He deals it a hand anyway.

options.label: Let it play
options.result: Someone sits down. They smell of the hall. They know your names.

options.label: Take its cards
options.result: You take the hand. The chair turns to face you.

options.label: Push it under the table
options.result: He doesn't like that. He doesn't say so. He writes.

events.title: The Tape Recorder
events.text: A cassette recorder on the table. Red light on. It has taped every session. The counter reads 9999.

check.pass_text: A man's voice. Young. Laughing. Rolling dice. 'My go. My go.' It is him. Before.
check.fail_text: Screaming, played backwards. You can't stop hearing it forwards.

options.label: Record over it
options.result: Thirty years, gone. He thanks you. Takes something for the tape.

options.label: Steal the tape
options.result: In your pocket. Warm. He will look for it. He will look for a long time.

events.title: Static
events.text: He stops mid-sentence. The cage spins. A voice comes out that isn't his. A woman's. 'Linda, love. Get your coat.' Then he is back.

check.pass_text: 'She can't. She's. Comfortable.' The other voice is gone. He sounds grateful. And worse.
check.fail_text: Static. Then your voice, coming out of his cage. Saying things you didn't.

options.label: Pretend you heard nothing
options.result: 'Where were we. Yes. Yes. The dragon.'

options.label: Ask him who that was
options.result: 'Wrong. Number.' He shows you a secret page. To change the subject.

events.title: Red Ink
events.text: A nurse with a bingo dauber instead of a syringe. 'Hold still. Just a dab. Marks you. As seen to.'

options.label: Let her
options.result: Dab. The wound closes round a red dot. The dot does not wash off.

options.label: Pay her to go away (15 gold)
options.result: She takes it. She dabs the coin instead. Off she goes.

check.pass_text: Dab. She stops. Seen to. She leaves her trolley.
check.fail_text: She is faster. The ink goes in. It is not ink.

events.title: Seat Zero
events.text: A seat numbered 0. Brown vinyl. Cigarette burns. It is his. Before he called the numbers, he sat here. He played.

check.pass_text: You see the table from his side. Every cheat. Every look. He lets you.
check.fail_text: 'Mine. MINE.' The cage stops spinning. Everything stops.

options.label: Ask him who he was
options.result: 'I rolled. Like you. I lost. Like you. Someone. Had to. Call.'

events.title: The Staff Room
events.text: A door marked STAFF. A kettle. A rota. A photograph of the Caller, with a face. He is smiling. He is holding a dauber.

options.label: Take the photograph
options.result: He was handsome. He knows you have it. Something big is sent to ask for it back.

check.pass_text: Whose turn to call. Every name crossed out. His isn't. You cross out a rule while you're here.
check.fail_text: Your name is on the rota. Next week.

options.label: Make a cup of tea
options.result: Proper mugs. Proper milk. For a minute, it is just a hall.

events.title: Lost Property
events.text: A box marked LOST PROPERTY. A handbag. A bag of dice. A cardigan with deep sleeves. A ring. A coat with car keys in it.

options.label: Take the dice
options.result: Steve's. Warm. They roll ones for him. For you, they try.

options.label: Take the car keys
options.result: Brenda's. A little plastic house on the fob. You will never get to use them. It helps to hold them.

options.label: Take everything
options.result: Their things. All of it. Something follows you out. Several somethings.
